Package com.lemarketjames.market.entity

Class MarketQuoteEntity

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.market.entity.MarketQuoteEntity
@Entity public class MarketQuoteEntity extends Object
Latest persisted price for one instrument (market_quotes, one row per instrument).

Live prices are held in memory by the simulator; this row is refreshed every few seconds so the market resumes from where it left off after a restart.

lastUpdated is stored as a UTC LocalDateTime because the existing column is TIMESTAMP (without time zone).
